title: Exact MCMC for Choices from Menus—Measuring Substitution and Complementarity Among Menu Items
authors: Tetyana Kosyakova; Thomas Otter; Sanjog Misra; Christian Neuerburg
eligible_reason: Bayesian methods paper: exact MCMC (perfect sampling) for a multivariate menu-choice model measuring substitution and complementarity, with pricing implications. No treatment, no DiD.
design_notes: code_MCM_model_with_Exchange_newBayesm_update.R implements the sampler; read_me_update.txt documents arguments and lists data_generation, posterior_analysis, prediction and OPTpricing scripts that are not in the archive.
data_files_note: No data files; the archive holds the sampler code, the readme and a PDF on user impatience.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
